dedupe_keys.name: a manually annotated corpus in french for the study of urbanization and the natural risk prevention

description: A manually annotated corpus in French for the study of urbanization and the natural risk prevention is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Maksim Koptelov et al. Land artificialization is a serious problem of civilization. Urban planning and natural risk management are aimed to improve it. In France, these practices operate the Local Land Plans (PLU – Plan Local d’Urbanisme) and the Natural risk prevention plans (PPRn – Plan de Prévention des Risques naturels) containing land use rules. Coverage: national (FR); published in 2023. Formats: TXT, ZIP, PDF. The data are held in recherche.data.gouv.fr and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence of the data is not stated in the sources read (the paper itself is open access). Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
